The '''Battle of Borleias''' was a battle of [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]], during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. As part of [[Tsavong Lah]]'s [[Battle Plan Coruscant]], [[Yuuzhan Vong]] forces took [[Borleias/Legends|Borleias]] to use as a staging area for the attack on Coruscant, enabling them to bypass the [[Bilbringi Shipyards]]. During the battle, they planted [[dovin basal]]s on the [[Blackmoon]], using a variant of the [[Yo'gand's Core]] tactic to sweep up the planet's orbital defense platforms over the course of its 32-hour orbit.

As a result of the attack, [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] [[Borsk Fey'lya]] ordered all [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|New Republic Defense Force]] officers to coordinate with the [[New Jedi Order]]. During the battle, Tsavong Lah received his [[radank]] arm from [[Vaecta]].

The system was later [[Battle of Borleias (Yuuzhan Vong War; Second)|re-captured]] by New Republic forces, representing a major turning point in the war.
